title_original: 자살예방 및 생명존중문화 조성을 위한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Appendix (Rules for the Enforcement of the Act on the Promotion of Mental Health and the Provision of Welfare Services for Individuals with Mental Disorders) [No. 497, May 30, 2017]

Article 1 (Effective Date) This rule shall take effect from May 30, 2017.

Articles 2 through 10 omitted

Article 11 (Amendments to Other Laws) Items ① through ⑧ omitted

⑨ The following amendments are made to some of the rules for the enforcement of laws to promote suicide prevention and the creation of a culture of respect for life:

Article 2, paragraph 1, item 4 is amended as follows:

    4. "Mental Health Promotion and Welfare Service Provision for Individuals with Mental Disorders Act" Article 16, referring to mental health research institutions.

Article 3, paragraph 4, replacing "Mental Health Center in accordance with Article 13(2) of the Mental Health Act" with "Mental Health Welfare Center in accordance with Article 15 of the Mental Health Promotion and Welfare Service Provision for Individuals with Mental Disorders Act".

Articles 10 through 12 omitted

Article 12 omitted
